# Imperial College London

> Imperial College London is a world-leading STEMB university focused on science, technology, engineering, medicine and business research and education.

Imperial College London operates multiple campuses including South Kensington, White City, and Silwood Park, with a strong commitment to research excellence, student support, and addressing global challenges through science and innovation.

## Study and Admissions

- [Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study): Study opportunities hub covering undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programs
- [Course search | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/courses): Searchable course directory for undergraduate and postgraduate programs
- [Apply | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/apply): Application process and requirements for all degree levels at Imperial
- [Fees and funding | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/fees-and-funding): Tuition fees, scholarships and financial support for Imperial students
- [International students | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/international-students): International student support, visas and entry requirements for UK study
- [Visit | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/visit): Campus tours, open days and virtual tours for prospective students
- [Summer schools | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/visit/summer-schools): Summer school programs for high school and university students
- [Help centre | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/help-centre): FAQs and support for admissions, fees and student services
- [Request info | Study | Imperial College London](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/study/request-info): Information request form and mailing list signup for prospective students
